response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, long-tenured software engineer (19+ years) with strong full-stack and systems programming breadth, satisfying the baseline experience and education requirements. However, the role calls for a Director-level AI strategy leader with deep, demonstrated AI/cloud expertise and a track record of advising strategic customers on AI adoption — none of which is substantiated here. AI exposure is limited to a few months of MCP/agentic tooling work at the current job, there's no advanced AI/ML degree, no cloud specialization, and career titles (Senior/Staff) don't reflect director-level scope or strategic influence.
strengths: Extensive 19+ year career spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure engineering
Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor, and run workshops/talks (community engagement)
Comfortable across diverse tech stacks (TypeScript, DLang, C/C++, Java) showing strong adaptability
concerns: Minimal and very recent AI experience (only since April 2025), no demonstrated AI products/platforms
No advanced degree in AI/ML and no cloud-specific specialization or certifications
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff-level titles, not clear evidence of Director-level strategic or cross-org influence

key_factors.factor: Long, broad engineering experience meeting tenure requirement
